C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 751
Date 11/12/16
AM
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

December 9th 1916

Sir,
    Twelve rebel leaders held a meeting in Yong Shung
Lien Kwan 永安旅馆 hotel in Rue Palikao at 7 p.m.
on 8th inst for the purpose of deciding ways and means
to raise further funds to assist rebels still in
Shanghai to return home. Two were appointed as
delegates to interview the members of the Chamber
of Commerce. These will request further assistance
and ask that General Li Tsung Woo be called upon to
produce his accounts.
    It is reported that two bombs were found when
the Kiukiang Road theatre was being cleaned at
12.30 a.m. 9th instant. Performances have been held
in this theatre for the past four nights in aid
of destitute rebels.
    The two delegates who have come from Tientsin
in connection with the Laoshikai incident have called
on Zee Kou Liang 席寇良 and requested him to find a
suitable place in the City to hold a public meeting.
Zee promised to consider the matter.
    It is reported that Dr. Sun Yat Sen will soon
leave for Peking.
    General Yang will visit Sungkiang to-morrow.

                    Your Obedient Servant,
                    W B newman /
                    Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事侦缉处
外交部登记号
第 751 号
日期 1916年12月11日
上午
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部）

1916年12月9日

先生：
    十二名叛乱首领于本月8日下午7时，在帕里考路（Rue Palikao）的永安旅馆（Yong Shung Lien Kwan）举行会议，旨在决定筹集更多资金的方式和方法，以协助仍滞留在上海的叛乱分子返回家乡。会议指派两人为代表，去拜访商会成员。这些代表将请求进一步援助，并要求李宗武（Li Tsung Woo，音译）将军公布其账目。
    据报，本月9日凌晨12时30分，在清理九江路剧院时发现了两枚炸弹。过去四个晚上，该剧院一直举行演出，为贫困的叛乱分子筹款。
    因老闸事件（Laoshikai incident）从天津来的两名代表已拜访了席寇良（Zee Kou Liang），并请他在市内寻找一个合适的地点举行公开集会。席氏答应考虑此事。
    据报，孙中山博士即将前往北京。
    杨将军将于明日访问松江。

                    您顺从的仆人，
                    W B 纽曼 /
                    侦探副督察。

警察总监。
